validationStatusMeaning.source: brains/moon/research/GAPS.json MOON-VAL-001 (stop condition: a preregistered comparison against an independent illuminance dataset, public sky-quality or lux records near fleet lakes, is scored). Unlike Weather and Generation, the Moon plan has NO pre-registered validation thresholds yet (MOON_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 7 item 3).
validationStatusMeaning.preRegistrationRequired: VALIDATED and PARTIAL both require a MOON-VAL-001 pre-registration committed BEFORE any illuminance data is read: dataset, sites, nights, metric and pass thresholds. This rubric does not set them.
validationStatusMeaning.statedProxy: Measured on-water illuminance (lux) is the target truth. The stated proxy is zenith night-sky brightness from public sky-quality-meter records (mag/arcsec^2, converted so brighter = more light) at sites near fleet lakes. Field sky-quality-meter readings from a boat are optional extra evidence, never required (MOON-VAL-001).
validationStatusMeaning.proposedCriteriaForPreRegistration: PROPOSAL ONLY, not pre-registered, for Michael to accept, change or reject when MOON-VAL-001 is pre-registered: (a) the published moonlightIndex A ranks site-nights by measured light with Spearman rho >= 0.6 over >= 60 site-nights at >= 3 sites; (b) the class order holds: median measured light DARK < MOSTLY_DARK < SOME_MOONLIGHT < BRIGHT_MOON; (c) both on nights with basis MOON_AND_CLOUD.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: The pre-registered comparison PASSES on measured illuminance (lux), or on the stated proxy at sites within the distance the pre-registration fixes.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: The pre-registered comparison PASSES only on MOON_ONLY nights (clear-sky ordering), or only on a proxy dataset farther from fleet lakes than pre-registered.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Anything else, including no pre-registration, a FAIL, or an insufficient sample. A FAIL produces a DARKNESS_RULE_V2 proposal; V1 results are kept.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The Moon Brain's validation record (a reviewed change that writes /validation/moon), never the scorer.
